title: Things That Go! Bold & Easy Coloring Book for Toddlers
subtitle: Trucks, Diggers, Garbage Trucks, Tractors & More: 50 Big Simple Pictures for Ages 1-4
author: Crayon Cove Press
description_html:
Vroom! 50 bold and easy vehicle pictures for toddlers.

  • Dump truck, digger, garbage truck, bulldozer, cement mixer, crane, monster truck, fire truck, tractor, train, rocket, boats and more
  • Thick lines and big spaces for chunky crayons
  • 50 single-sided pages: no bleed-through
  • Each picture labelled with a big hollow word to colour
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages
